description: L1 phase G1 bounded population: six real roots from Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Defs (three structures, three theorems) plus core Nat.add_comm, exported through the pinned lean4export toolchain (mathlib4 commit c5ea00351c28e24afc9f0f84379aa41082b1188f, lean4export commit a3e35a584f59b390667db7269cd37fca8575e4bf) and merged by declaration name. This population is committed BEFORE extraction runs: coverage is measured against these expected_roots, not against whatever a run happened to produce.
note: expected_declaration_count is filled in by gen-declaration-graph.py's --write-population-count flag AFTER a run, but expected_roots above is the authority the checker reads and never edits automatically -- see scripts/check-declaration-graph.py's MISSING_ROOT guard.
